objective.title: Qualify bounded tensor shape and resource research oracles

declared.summary: Qualify M7-W01-C02-T1 as bounded tensor research: demonstrate an independent 2x2x2 row-major sum/index oracle, explicit shape mismatch and 64-element/512-byte refusal limits, and a provider/ownership screen. Complete T1 Q/O/D only; keep C02/W01/M7 active. No tensor API, external provider, GPU, implicit broadcasting or public package.
declared.value: Record one local BCL-only read-only oracle program, its exact reference values, shape/count/budget negative cases and staged source SHA identities. Keep current Math numerical contracts and deferred C01 precision disposition intact. Candidate tensor provider/consumer admission and size/shape policy remain separate T2 work.
debtChanges: No tensor product API is delivered by research-only rank-three BCL shape/index witnesses.
Tensor adoption requires a named operation and consumer, layout/type/stride and resource budgets plus independent refusal tests.
Reject implicit broadcast, reshape, sparse conversion, hidden copies and cross-rank assumptions in future contracts.
Any managed/native provider needs immutable source/version, license/notices, target RID and source-free consumer proof before adoption.
C02-T2, C02 phase, W01 and M7 remain incomplete; tensor research does not authorize AURA job/UI integration.
declared.nextAction: On durable RS108 success, prepare M7-W01-C02-T2 to decide an explicitly bounded tensor API with real consumer/source-free tests or defer with a review trigger. Do not infer an advanced tensor engine or copy AURA scheduling and UI code.
